name: suivi-chrono
description: Application de suivi chronométré des tâches

scripts.build:android: npm run copy && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.build:ios: npm run copy && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.copy: mkdir -p www && cp -r css html js manifest.json www/
scripts.minify:js: terser js/main.js -c drop_console=true -m -o js/main.js && terser js/formulaire.js -c drop_console=true -m -o js/formulaire.js && terser js/buttons.js -c drop_console=true -m -o js/buttons.js && terser js/modal.js -c drop_console=true -m -o js/modal.js && terser js/chrono.js -c drop_console=true -m -o js/chrono.js && terser js/resume.js -c drop_console=true -m -o js/resume.js && terser js/service-worker.js -c -m -o js/service-worker.js
scripts.minify:css: cleancss -O2 -o css/style.css css/style.css && cleancss -O2 -o css/formulaire.css css/formulaire.css && cleancss -O2 -o css/buttons.css css/buttons.css && cleancss -O2 -o css/resume.css css/resume.css && cleancss -O2 -o css/value-types.css css/value-types.css
scripts.minify:html: html-minifier-terser --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --remove-redundant-attributes --remove-empty-attributes --use-short-doctype --minify-css true --minify-js true -o html/formulaire.html html/formulaire.html && html-minifier-terser --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --remove-redundant-attributes --remove-empty-attributes --use-short-doctype --minify-css true --minify-js true -o html/button.html html/button.html && html-minifier-terser --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --remove-redundant-attributes --remove-empty-attributes --use-short-doctype --minify-css true --minify-js true -o html/resume.html html/resume.html && html-minifier-terser --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --use-short-doctype --minify-css true --minify-js true -o index.html index.html
scripts.minify: npm run minify:js && npm run minify:css && npm run minify:html
